name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including its private client note. The compact doc-client-note-open entry opens a modal prefilled with email subject, email body, and WhatsApp; applying changes participates in the unsaved guard, and save persists the exact three values. Failed or rejected saves retain the note draft. The existing content/status, client/project association, backlinks, Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview, and dual PDF download remain available.
